obfuscation_indicators: ability to generate profits remains uncertain
risk_summary: The disclosure presents substantial financial risk, including persistent net losses since 2009, declining revenue, continued operating cash burn, dependence on financing or cost reductions, and uncertainty regarding going-concern viability. Risk is partly obscured by extensive safe-harbor boilerplate and promotional descriptions of new blockchain and cloud initiatives, while the related-party VMSO transaction adds governance and execution complexity.
